title: Research: compose PR922 factory fusions with PR924 rescaling
body:
## Summary

PR922's factory contractions and PR924's coupled rescaling are compatible. Applying them in either order produces the same literal circuit: 32 scalar macros and 73 PR696 primitives per real-component block.

Either standalone contribution costs 77 primitives; their shared PR681 baseline costs 81. Fresh reconstruction and complete primitive replay establish that the savings add up across all fourteen raw-factory windows and inverse cleanups.

Finite construction and scoped exact verification. No new κ; the selected conditional κ remains 0.001661634653669567.

## Exact result

| Construction | Macros/block | PR696 primitives/block | Full forward | Full backward |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Baseline | 34 | 81 | 123,768 | 123,784 |
| PR922 | 32 | 77 | 123,544 | 123,560 |
| PR924 | 34 | 77 | 123,544 | 123,560 |
| Combined | 32 | 73 | 123,320 | 123,336 |

The combination saves 448 primitives per orientation against baseline, or 224 beyond either PR alone. This is about 5.2% fewer primitives per block and 0.18% fewer across the full raw program compared with either standalone contribution.

The combined circuit retains PR922's 15,456 emitted macros and 319,104 adapter allowance. Its conservative local PR696 bound decreases from PR922's 8,275,750,478,504 to 8,275,750,478,280: another 224.

Helpers, registers, centers, recursive children and paid profile are unchanged. Positive prefix bounds remain PR922's 39,090 / 1,301,331; exact primitive prefix row-l1 maxima remain 124 / 107; fractional depth remains two bits.

These are operation counts and a retained local recount, not runtime measurements or a global invoice replay.

## What is new

The original contributions established their improvements separately and left compatibility untested. This follow-up:

- Reconstructs both pinned witnesses and verifies both application orders.
- Tracks original gate labels so deletions cannot silently shift splice sites.
- Rebuilds baseline, PR922, PR924 and the combination.
- Replays all eight complete primitive projections on 725 arbitrary input columns each.
- Establishes the combined local accounting without double-counting either predecessor.

The original PR924 certificate and its restricted 67-primitive gauge optimum remain intact. That optimum concerns the original fixed 28-addition topology; no optimality claim is made for this combined 26-addition circuit.

COMPOSITION.json pins the retained PR922 circuit and four consumed PR924 files. SOURCE-PINS.json pins all sixteen shared predecessor inputs. The retained PR922 circuit is byte-identical to its pinned source.

## Reproduce

From the repository root:

    python3 -I -B research/complex-factory-gauge38/compose_pr922.py

Expected:

    PASS_FACTORY_PR922_PR924_COMPOSITION macros=32 primitives=73 blocks=14 saved=448,448 extra_vs_each=224,224 controls=38 no_new_kappa

Verification uses only the Python standard library; no solver, network or PR922 checkout is required.

## Tests executed

PASS on Linux, CPython 3.12.14:

- Normal full replay matching every field of COMPOSITION-RESULT.json.
- Seven package tests, including a full optimized isolated replay from a minimal offline checkout with spaces and repacked gzip inputs.
- Both application orders and all four local orientations.
- Eight complete primitive projections, 725 arbitrary columns each.
- 38 local rejection controls, including deletion of every combined gate, wrong fusion order/sign/frame, Boolean coefficients, extra cost and omitted work clearing.
- Complete missing-cleanup rejection and four inherited native controls per rebuilt word.
- Fresh PR922 native receipt exactly matching its pinned retained result.
- Original PR924 local certificate and 46 controls.
- make selected-record-check and whitespace checks.

No final verification failure remains.

## Limitations

Scope is the historical raw factory. Selected-provider transport, phase lowering, whole-owner hosting, global invoices and outer assembly remain undone. Uniform compilation, realization, recursive precision/tape and analytic assumptions remain inherited.

Full make verify, selected frontier799 cold replay, Lean, other Python versions and remote CI were not run for this follow-up. Finite replay is not formal verification of the multiplication theorem. No selected record or upstream/ file changes.

Updated this PR with the verified composition of PR922’s contractions and PR924’s rescaling.

The combination uses 32 macros and 73 PR696 primitives per block, versus 77 for either PR alone. Full raw-factory replay confirms an additional saving of 224 primitives per orientation beyond either standalone contribution.

Verification and reproduction instructions are in the updated description and COMPOSITION.md. No new κ.
